Responsabilidades da Posição

O Executivo de Contas é responsável por gerenciar e expandir a carteira de clientes, promovendo o relacionamento estratégico e garantindo a satisfação dos mesmos. Este profissional deve atuar como um elo entre o cliente e a empresa, buscando entender suas necessidades e oferecendo soluções adequadas.

  • Gerenciar e desenvolver relacionamentos com clientes existentes e potenciais.
  • Identificar oportunidades de negócios e realizar prospecção ativa.
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais personalizadas de acordo com as necessidades do cliente.
  • Realizar visitas a clientes para entender suas demandas e oferecer suporte.
  • Negociar contratos e condições comerciais com clientes.
  • Monitorar o desempenho das contas e garantir a satisfação do cliente.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes internas para garantir a entrega de serviços.
  • Preparar relatórios de vendas e análises de mercado.
  • Participar de eventos e feiras do setor para promover a empresa.
  • Acompanhar tendências de mercado e concorrência para propor melhorias.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência prévia em vendas ou atendimento a clientes
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Capacidade de negociação e persuasão
  • Conhecimento em produtos e serviços financeiros
  • Habilidade em análise de mercado e identificação de oportunidades
  • Proatividade e orientação para resultados
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e em ambiente dinâmico
  • Domínio de ferramentas de CRM e Excel
  • Disponibilidade para viagens quando necessário

Entregas e Resultados Esperados

  • Gestão eficaz de relacionamentos com clientes.
  • Atingimento de metas de vendas e receitas.
  • Identificação de novas oportunidades de negócios.
  • Desenvolvimento de propostas comerciais personalizadas.
  • Acompanhamento e análise de indicadores de performance.
  • Realização de reuniões de alinhamento com clientes.
  • Treinamento e suporte para a equipe interna.
  • Feedback contínuo para melhoria de serviços.
  • Participação em eventos e networking do setor.
  • Relatórios periódicos sobre o andamento das contas.

Sobre a Empresa

A Omie é uma plataforma de gestão empresarial e software ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) que oferece soluções para pequenas e médias empresas no Brasil. Ela é conhecida por facilitar a gestão de diversas áreas de um negócio, como financeiro, vendas, compras, estoques e serviços.

A franquia Omie Batel refere-se a uma unidade da Omie situada no centro de Curitiba, Paraná. A unidade Batel atua como um ponto de apoio regional para a venda e suporte da plataforma Omie, oferecendo consultoria e treinamento para empresas que desejam implementar ou melhorar sua gestão utilizando o software.

Os franqueados da Omie são responsáveis por ajudar os clientes a entenderem e utilizarem as ferramentas da plataforma para melhorar a eficiência operacional e a tomada de decisões empresariais. A franquia oferece treinamento inicial e contínuo para os franqueados, além de suporte em marketing e vendas.

description:
Landis+Gyr is a leading global provider of integrated energy management solutions. We measure and analyze energy utilization to generate empowering analytics for smart grid and infrastructure management, enabling utilities and consumers to reduce energy consumption. Our innovative and proven portfolio of software, services and intelligent sensor technology is a key driver to decarbonize the grid and helped to avoid around 9 million tons of CO2 in FY 2023. With sales of USD 2.0 billion in FY 2023, Landis+Gyr employs around 6,900 talented people across five continents .

For more than a century, we've been pioneers in energy innovation, and we continue to lead the way toward a more sustainable and efficient energy landscape.

Join us at Landis+Gyr, where we manage energy better!

About the Role
We are looking for a Power System Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development of a cloud-based utility analytics product with embedded power system functionalities. This role offers the opportunity to be involved throughout the entire product lifecycle — from design and implementation to testing and customer support. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to transform market and customer needs into robust software solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical guidance to the analytics product development team regarding use cases that require power system functionalities such as power flow, optimal power flow, short circuits, transients, stability, arc flash, harmonics, and grounding.

  • Collaborate with Product Owners to write clear and comprehensive product specifications for design and software teams.

  • Work closely with technical leads to ensure adherence to product-related system design guidelines.

  • Leverage deep technical knowledge to propose innovative solutions addressing steady-state and dynamic behaviors of power distribution systems.

  • Participate in pre-sales activities, supporting the technical validation of proposed solutions.

  • Act as a subject matter expert in discussions with clients and partners, addressing queries related to power system analysis within our analytics offering.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Power Engineering. Focus on power distribution, transmission modeling, and analysis (e.g., state estimation, power flow, short circuit analysis, optimization, energy markets) is highly valued.

  • Experience (2+ years preferred) in electric power engineering, including power system modeling, grid simulations, and operations.

  • Familiarity with tools for power system studies such as PowerFactory, PSS/E, or equivalent (dynamic and EMT simulation) is a plus.

  • Experience with software development and scripting (Python preferred) is a strong advantage.

  • Proven ability to analyze complex technical requirements and translate them into software functionalities.

  • Ability to work both independently and in a collaborative, cross-disciplinary team environment.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to interact with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Passion for problem-solving and working in an open, supportive team culture.

At Diaverum , we are looking for a business-oriented and hands-on HR Director to lead our HR function in Brazil. This role is critical in attracting, developing, and retaining top talent while ensuring a positive, inclusive, and compliant work environment.

Everyone deserves a fulfilling life. That’s why we’re dedicated to enhancing the lives of renal patients.

As a global leader and the largest independent renal service provider in Europe, we have 13,000 healthcare professionals caring for around 41,000 patients across 450 clinics in 24 countries globally . We provide renal care personalized to patients’ needs and choices, offering a portfolio of treatments ranging from preventive care, hemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis and home care, to the coordination of patients’ comorbidities and holiday dialysis.

Our vision is to transform renal care, delivering and broadening access to the highest quality of kidney care for patients around the world . At the heart of what we do is our standardized care delivery model, continuously evolving digital & AI infrastructure and people caring for patients with competence, passion and inspiration.

Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden, Diaverum is part of the M42 group of companies , a first-of-its-kind integrated health powerhouse committed to the sustainable future of health.

Diaverum Brazil ranks first in the number of patients within the Diaverum group and is the second-largest player in the Brazilian market. The company provides renal services through its own clinics and as a third-party provider for hospitals, treating 4,500 chronic patients across 12 clinics, performing 75,000 treatments per month. Headquartered in São Paulo, its clinics are located in the São Paulo metropolitan region and the state of Sergipe, while also serving hospitals in São Paulo, Sergipe, Bahia, and João Pessoa. Diaverum Brazil has a team of 1,200 direct employees and 200 contracted nephrologists. The HR team consists of 16 members, with two based at the headquarters and the rest distributed across the clinics. With an average business growth of over 30% per year, the company is currently developing and deploying HR IT systems in a dynamic, flexible, and multidisciplinary environment.

As a key member of the Management Team , you will play a pivotal role in driving the HR strategy, talent development, employee relations, and compliance with local labour laws , ensuring alignment with global HR standards and company goals.

Reporting to the Country Manager Brazil, this role is based in São Paulo (headquarters in the Vila Olímpia neighborhood) and requires between 20% and 40% local travel.

  • Develop and implement a business-driven HR strategy , supporting the organizational structure with leadership.
  • Act as an ambassador and change agent , ensuring that Diaverum’s culture and values are a living reality.
  • Represent HR in the Country Management Team and Brazil in the global HR team , contributing to continuous improvement projects.
  • Be a visible and hands-on partner for senior leaders, managers, and employees.
  • Ensure labour law compliance and provide guidance on employment matters.
  • Equip clinic managers with HR tools to become strong “people managers.”
  • Support in talent acquisition, performance management, compensation, and development .
  • Oversee payroll, contracts, and HR administration .
  • Manage the full employee lifecycle , including recruitment, onboarding, engagement, and performance reviews.
  • Support M&A activities , ensuring a seamless HR operational transition .
  • Lead workforce planning , ensuring talent attraction and retention.
  • Contribute to budget planning and labour efficiency initiatives with Finance and Operations.
  • Measure and report on key HR data to drive decision-making.
  • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures aligned with corporate standards.
  • Ensure HR tools are available and used effectively across the business.
  • Educate managers and employees on HR processes, including creating employee handbooks and onboarding materials.

People & Organizational Development

  • Lead organizational design initiatives with the management team.
  • Drive learning & development, ensuring training programs support business needs.
  • Oversee employee onboarding, ensuring a strong integration into Diaverum’s culture and values.
  • Lead succession planning for key management roles and specialists.
  • Implement the annual performance appraisal process, ensuring clear goal setting and development plans.
  • Support restructuring initiatives to optimize the organization’s effectiveness.
  • Oversee payroll and benefits administration , ensuring compliance and efficiency.
  • Implement a structured annual compensation review process based on market benchmarks and performance.
  • Develop compensation strategies that drive a high-performance culture .

ABOUT YOU

You have 8-10 years of experience in HR across multiple disciplines and a proven track record in leading change within multilevel organizations . Your strong business acumen allows you to align HR strategies with company goals, and you have an in-depth understanding of Brazilian labour law . You have worked in an international environment , and if you have experience in the healthcare industry , that’s a big plus. You hold a university degree in HR, Finance, or a related field , and you are fluent in English . You are comfortable using MS Office and other HR tools to support business operations.

You are a customer-focused HR leader with strong relationship-building skills. You take a hands-on approach , ensuring HR strategies are not only well-designed but also effectively executed. Your communication, listening, and coaching skills allow you to support both employees and managers, creating a positive and productive work environment. As a change agent , you have the ability to lead HR transformations and integration processes, making a real impact on the business. You have a continuous improvement mindset , always striving to optimize processes and enhance the employee experience.

If you have experience in an international company and a background in the healthcare industry , that would be a plus!

description:

Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, Workflows, AI/ML & Analytics

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, Workflows, AI/ML & Analytics role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, Workflows, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.
As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on end-to-end data analytics and MLOps solutions composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.
We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.
Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hours! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.
What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
  • Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers
  • Debug issues and interact in public with upstream and Ubuntu communities
  • Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional or academic software delivery using Python
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional skills that would be nice to have
The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions, data pipelines, or orchestrating workflows for the cloud.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on an open source project
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Join to apply for the Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management to work on authorization and access management across Canonical's suite of enterprise products and web services, using Go (Golang) and Python.
As a software engineer for Identity Management products of Canonical, you will modernize and expand the capabilities of the identity management solutions we use for authentication and authorization in our products, as well as our canonical.com and ubuntu.com websites. Your work on Identity Management will directly impact the users of all Canonical products.
Technical excellence and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to own the design and delivery of the system, facilitate integrations and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA and AMER regions.
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Go (Golang) and optionally Python
  • Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Create and enhance management, authentication and authorization API endpoints
  • Craft end-user authentication flows from design to implementation
  • Modernize the identity stack of our websites and products by driving adoption of best-of-breed IAM technologies
  • Deliver great products that users love by maintaining a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You are a software engineer, with specific experience building identity and access management products
  • You are familiar with the open source software, standards, protocols and concepts in the identity space (e.g. OpenID, OAuth, LDAP)
  • You have experience implementing authorization frameworks in distributed systems
  • You value secure coding and standards, and enjoy working on teams that do the same
  • You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform
In addition:
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Sr Product Manager - Regionalization, Delivery Experience
description:
Sr Product Manager - Regionalization, Delivery Experience

At Amazon Brazil, we value Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) in all our job positions. We act intentionally to ensure our internal environment reflects the plurality of the businesses we play and the customers we serve.
In Brazil, we have a Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion squad formed by representatives from different roles and areas, as we understand that this agenda must have different perspectives and multiple experiences. Our leadership is committed to sharing and acting on our leadership principles, with the purpose of ‘Strive to Be Earth's Best Employer’. We recognize our responsibility and need for change, understanding that ‘Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility’. Our affinity groups are built from volunteers from different businesses and actively participate in defining our DE&I strategies. They act as ambassadors of this agenda and will support you from Day1. Remember, at Amazon ‘It’s always Day1’. Our groups are organized in the following fronts: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+), and People With Disabilities.
For millions of customers worldwide, the Amazon name is synonymous with delivery – and the Delivery Experience (DEX) team provides those customers with innovative ways to get what they want and need, enabling the choices they make on every order, every day. We combine customer impact with retail invention, solving huge technical challenges along the way.

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon.com.br is an important and fast-growing business for Amazon.

We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager to lead Delivery Experience Regionalization. You'll be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining high-impact processes and supporting teams that help us deliver on our customer promise seamlessly. This role will partner closely with Amazon Transportation, Operations, Finance, Retail, and WW DEX leadership to solve customer-facing shipping solutions.

Key job responsibilities:

  1. Define and deliver important programs with broad cross-functional and cross-organizational business impact.
  2. Lead the design, implementation, and delivery of a highly complicated cross-functional project in a new business area.
  3. Delivery strategy: work closely with team leadership to define priorities for delivery strategy internally and with partners, using data to create and communicate business plans to senior leadership.
  4. Product Definition: incorporate benchmarking information from local competitors as well as best practices and lessons learned from other geographies to define best-in-class customer experience.
  5. Support and own the design and development of projects, working through all related dependencies with internal and external teams, mainly Operations, Transportation, Buyer Risk Prevention, and Technology teams.
  6. Develop customer requirements (user stories, use cases) and business requirements, participating in the design of the user experience, release goals, and prioritization of assigned features according to customer value.
  7. Bring strong, data-driven business and strategic judgment to decisions.
  8. Develop business and process requirements, prioritize needs, and manage milestones and overall roadmap.
  9. Enhance Amazon delivery experience, including the definition of shipping prices and shipping promotions.
  10. Bring analytical horsepower, enhanced Excel skills (and ideally SQL), and a deep curiosity about how things work.
  11. Identify and develop opportunities for improved cash flow in Shipping Programs.
  12. Engage with senior leadership on drafting proposals for new concepts, improvement plans, 3-year strategy, and outlook.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Relevant years of product or program management, product marketing, business development, or technology experience.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition.
- Experience with end-to-end product delivery.
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product.
- Experience as a product manager or owner.
- Experience owning technology products.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data-driven insights.
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders.

  • Design and implement Kubernetes-based infrastructure with service mesh (Istio, Linkerd) for scalability and security.
  • Lead the integration of edge computing and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) to enable real-time data processing and decision-making.
  • Develop high-performance microservices architectures using event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, MQTT).
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) strategies with Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi.
  • Ensure high availability and disaster recovery for mission-critical mining applications.
  • Optimize resource allocation and cost efficiency using AI-driven cloud orchestration techniques.
  • Work closely with AI, networking, and data engineering teams to ensure seamless deployment and scalability.
  • Define best practices for security, compliance, and observability (IAM, Zero Trust, SRE principles).
  • Drive CI/CD automation, improving deployment cycles and system reliability.

Key Skills And Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in cloud software engineering, distributed systems, and cloud orchestration.
  • Expertise in Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, and container orchestration in hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
  • Strong programming experience in Golang, Python, or Rust for cloud-native development.
  • Deep knowledge of serverless computing (Lambda, Knative), service mesh (Istio, Consul), and edge computing frameworks.
  • Experience with real-time streaming data processing frameworks (Apache Flink, Spark Streaming, or TensorFlow Serving).
  • Familiarity with 5G, TSN (Time-Sensitive Networking), and IoT networking protocols.
  • Proven experience in multi-cloud security, authentication (OAuth, JWT, OpenID Connect), and compliance (ISO 27001, IEC 62443).
  • Strong knowledge of DevOps and SRE principles, including CI/CD pipelines (GitOps, ArgoCD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in industrial automation, mining, or telecom environments.
  • Knowledge of AI model deployment, optimization, and inference at scale.
  • Experience with hybrid cloud and edge computing strategies.
  • Understanding of decentralized orchestration frameworks is a plus.

Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to tackle complex distributed systems challenges.
  • Effective collaboration across AI, networking, DevOps, and product teams.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to mentor junior engineers.

The Talent Acquisition Operations (TA Ops) team enables Nubank’s Talent Acquisition function to scale with consistency, speed, and quality. We operate and evolve the core systems and processes that support hiring while designing solutions that support recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates throughout their journeys. Design and maintain seamless data flows between systems, ensuring integration supports efficient processes while upholding data integrity and security across all automation workflows.

SSE is a multinational company with Italian roots and over 40 years of history, beginning operations in 1984 in the Prato region.

Junte-se à nossa equipe!

Venha fazer parte de nossa missão de elevar a autoestima e a beleza de cada pessoa que passa por nossas portas.

A Ad Clinic é uma referência em estética e bem-estar, dedicada a oferecer tratamentos inovadores e personalizados que visam transformar a autoestima de nossos clientes. Com uma abordagem focada na qualidade, segurança e resultados efetivos, nossa clínica combina tecnologia de ponta com um time altamente capacitado de profissionais.

Estamos sempre à frente das tendências do mercado estético, buscando continuamente inovações que garantam a satisfação de nossos clientes. Acreditamos no potencial de cada colaborador e investimos em treinamento e desenvolvimento, criando um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inspirador.

Nosso compromisso é proporcionar não apenas experiências transformadoras para nossos clientes, mas também oportunidades de crescimento profissional para nossa equipe. Requisitos e qualificações


  1. Formação em Biomedicina com especialização em Estética e registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Biomedicina (CRBM 6).

A Kryptus é uma empresa brasileira com atuação global, especializada em cibersegurança e proteção de dados sensíveis . Quer ajudar o país a reduzir sua dependência tecnológica externa e, assim, subir mais um degrau rumo à soberania nacional? Que tal experimentar novos desafios técnicos em projetos com as Forças Armadas e grandes empresas parceiras do setor aeronáutico e de defesa?

Para atender essas demandas, estamos buscando Desenvolvedores de Firmware experientes para se juntarem ao nosso time.

Os profissionais atuarão de forma 100% presencial em projetos estratégicos de defesa, desenvolvendo, testando e integrando sistemas para uso em aeronaves e radares.

Main responsibilities

  1. Atuar na definição de arquitetura de sistemas embarcados;

  8. Manter o código-fonte e demais artefatos do projeto sob controle de versão;
  9. Executar revisões de código e contribuir com a qualidade do software produzido.

Requirements and skills

OBRIGATÓRIOS:

  • Graduação em Ciências da Computação, Engenharia Eletrônica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com microcontroladores das famílias MSP430 ou STM32;
  • Proficiência na linguagem C e em desenvolvimento de firmware bare-metal;
  • Ampla vivência na utilização de equipamentos de laboratório (analisador lógico, osciloscópio, multímetro, gerador de sinais etc.) e na exploração de documentação técnica (datasheets, manuais de referência, application notes etc.);
  • Inglês avançado para redação, leitura e comunicação oral;
  • Experiência com Git em linha de comando.

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em técnicas e padrões de codificação segura (CERT C, MISRA etc.);
  • Experiência com linguagem Assembly;
  • Experiência com linguagens de descrição de hardware (VHDL, Verilog etc.) e com dispositivos de lógica programável (CPLD e FPGA);
  • Conhecimento em criptografia e implementação de algoritmos criptográficos em microcontroladores.

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead one of our teams that work closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other world-class cloud partners to optimize Ubuntu for their infrastructure. Our team builds, tests, and publishes the base Ubuntu images used by millions to ensure optimal performance and security in their cloud estate. We aim to deliver the very best public cloud VM experience, as well as specialized images for specific purposes on each cloud. Our goal is to celebrate and enable their particular points of differentiation on their clouds, while also ensure a common operating experience for their users.
As an engineering manager you need to bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of your team. You will also need to represent the team in direct partner engagement. You'll be responsible for the stability and functionality that our cloud users have come to expect. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu image products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU-aided AI for servers, VM's and containers.
As an engineering manager at Canonical your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, doing valuable work, and generally having a great time at Canonical. As a lead for strong engineers, technical leadership and a solid background in software development is a must, so that you're able to challenge and grow your team members. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team is building with. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high performing team.
The role entails

  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your and similar timezones
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel up to 15% for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with at least one of Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Essa posição é para atuar em regime presencial em Contagem, MG.

Who will you be working with?

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.

Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!

How will you make a difference?

The Lead Engineer/Technologist – Train Control will work with customers, various suppliers, engineering teams, and industry agencies to identify and capture requirements to execute controls design and implementation. This group is made up of over a dozen subsystem functions and components and is the overall system integrator for third-party/customer-supplied equipment and a driver of overall infrastructure for the Locomotive Control System.

What do we want to know about you?

  1. Bachelor of Science in Engineering or related field;
  2. Proven experience in an engineering position;
  3. Experience with controls/software design, diagnostics, and test;
  4. Ability and willingness to work "hands-on" in test labs and on locomotives with high HP (1000 KVA), medium voltage (2 KV) and high current (10 KA) systems;
  5. Strong English technical writing and communication skills;
  6. Experience with MATLAB Simulink or other Modeling tools preferred.

What will your typical day look like?

The Lead Engineer/Technologist – Train Control will play a pivotal role in the development of the Locomotive Control System by executing a variety of projects from follow-on orders (Requisitions) through new product developments ensuring proper definition of requirements and interfaces for Locomotive Control Systems. The engineer will design, integrate, and validate Train Control subsystem functions for locomotives suitable for application in both English and non-English speaking environments by using sound engineering principles and adhering to business standards, practices, and procedures. In addition, the engineer will lead/support investigations for root-cause identification and resolution of reliability issues.

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.

Wabtec is a global company that invests not just in our products, but also our people by embracing diversity and inclusion. We care about our relationships with our employees and take pride in celebrating the variety of experiences, expertise, and backgrounds that bring us together. At Wabtec, we aspire to create a place where we all belong and where diversity is welcomed and appreciated.

To fulfill that commitment, we rely on a culture of leadership, diversity, and inclusion. We aim to employ the world’s brightest minds to help us create a limitless source of ideas and opportunities. title: Faça sua Carreira de Engenharia de Processos no Itaú --
description:
Vem construir no Itaú

Como maior banco privado da América Latina, acompanhamos de perto o desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias e enxergamos o processo como uma evolução natural do nosso negócio, que torna possível termos um contato ainda mais próximo com a experiência de nossos clientes para continuarmos aprimorando suas jornadas.

Como é a área de Operações?

Ao longo de nossa história, desempenhamos um papel fundamental na estratégia do Itaú Unibanco . Dentro deste contexto, todos os produtos que oferecemos aos nossos clientes passam a ser produtos tecnológicos, independente da interface que ele escolha – seja ela física, digital ou mista. Vem construir soluções digitais em uma das maiores instituições financeiras da América Latina!

Como é a Carreira de Engenharia de Processos?

A Engenharia de processos no Itaú exerce um papel fundamental na busca constante da melhor jornada para nossos clientes, vem pra repensar o fundamental (ir na causa raiz das coisas), buscar a reestruturação radical dos processos que visam alcançar mudanças disruptivas em indicadores críticos de desempenho, tais como qualidade, custos, riscos e agilidade. A pessoa engenheira de processos pode estar alocada em Squads, em comunidades ou nas áreas do banco atuando sempre em projetos de transformação e melhoria contínua (Build e Run).


Como será o seu dia a dia?

  1. Garantir a aplicabilidade dos métodos para transformação das Jornadas fim a fim dos clientes.
  2. Priorizar as ações quantificando o impacto através de uma Engenharia de Valor, garantindo assertividade nas escolhas que agregam.
  3. Atuar no mapeamento de processos, resolução de problemas, construção e redesenho de jornadas, com foco no cliente, eficiência, qualidade e gestão de riscos.
  4. Desdobrar as dores dos clientes e conectar com elementos de processo.
  5. Realizar o estudo e a construção dos requisitos para os desenvolvimentos de tecnologia dos problemas assegurando o reuso de soluções.
  6. Desenvolver soluções em No/Low-Code para transformação dos processos. Garantir o teste funcional e homologação de requisitos de processos nas soluções desenvolvidas.
  7. Estruturar Gestão e Controle dos processos, aplicando ferramentas de qualidade, planejamento de demanda, intervenções operacionais, process mining, gestão da rotina, entre outras.

*Modelo de trabalho: híbrido de 8x presenciais no mês


Quais são as habilidades e competências necessárias?

Principais habilidades técnicas com experiência prática:

  1. LEAN
  2. Qualidade
  3. PCP (Planejamento e Controle de Produção)
  4. Gestão de Projetos/ Métodos Ágeis
  5. Análise e exploração de Dados
  6. Process Mining
  7. Método de Solução de Problemas

Formação em Engenharia de Produção é um diferencial.

O que esperamos de você:

  1. Habilidade em criticar de forma construtiva e provocativa;
  2. Habilidade em negociação e construção de parcerias;
  3. Capacidade analítica/ lógica;
  4. Habilidade em conectar conhecimento técnico com a estratégia dos projetos;
  5. Organização, disciplina e pró-atividade;
  6. Habilidade em trabalhar em equipe de forma colaborativa;
  7. Capacidade de tomada de decisões com base em processos e dados, foco no cliente e resultados.

A Cultura Ituber

Para nós, a transformação começa quando olhamos para trás: reconhecemos tudo o que construímos juntos até aqui e nos orgulhamos, afinal, são quase 100 anos de história!

O nosso principal pilar é a ética: pra gente, ética é inegociável. Ou seja, nos comprometemos a fazer sempre o certo, sem jeitinhos, sem atalhos.

A partir desse pilar principal, temos os nossos outros direcionadores:

  1. A gente trabalha para o cliente;
  2. A gente não sabe tudo;
  3. A gente é movido por resultado;
  4. A gente quer diversidade e inclusão;
  5. A gente #VaiDeTurma!

Ao se tornar um Ituber você tem:

  1. Vale Transporte;
  2. Vale Refeição (Restaurantes) / Vale Alimentação (Supermercados);
  3. Convênio médico e odontológico;
  4. Seguro de Vida;
  5. PLR – Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (Mediante resultados do banco);
  6. Previdência privada;
  7. Descontos exclusivos em nossos produtos financeiros;
  8. Licença maternidade estendida & paternidade;
  9. Auxílio Creche / Babá (para papais e mamães);
  10. Incentivo a estudos;
  11. GymPass ou TotalPass;
  12. Acesso aos Clubes Itaú (Guarapiranga / Itanhaém e São Sebastião);
  13. + Algumas vantagens que você pode conhecer durante o processo.

*Estimulamos candidaturas de pessoas com deficiência em todas as nossas posições, sendo assim, sinta-se à vontade para se candidatar em vagas sinalizadas como exclusivas ou não para pessoas com deficiência. Somos comprometidos com a inclusão e valorizamos a diversidade.

MISSÃO: Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

VISÃO: Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

VALORES: Preservação da vida, Humanização, Dignidade, Transparência e Sustentabilidade.

Join to apply for the Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management to work on authorization and access management across Canonical's suite of enterprise products and web services, using Go (Golang) and Python.
As a software engineer for Identity Management products of Canonical, you will modernize and expand the capabilities of the identity management solutions we use for authentication and authorization in our products, as well as our canonical.com and ubuntu.com websites. Your work on Identity Management will directly impact the users of all Canonical products.
Technical excellence and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to own the design and delivery of the system, facilitate integrations and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA and AMER regions.
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Go (Golang) and optionally Python
  • Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Create and enhance management, authentication and authorization API endpoints
  • Craft end-user authentication flows from design to implementation
  • Modernize the identity stack of our websites and products by driving adoption of best-of-breed IAM technologies
  • Deliver great products that users love by maintaining a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You are a software engineer, with specific experience building identity and access management products
  • You are familiar with the open source software, standards, protocols and concepts in the identity space (e.g. OpenID, OAuth, LDAP)
  • You have experience implementing authorization frameworks in distributed systems
  • You value secure coding and standards, and enjoy working on teams that do the same
  • You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform
In addition:
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job Description

A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Responsibilities and assignments

  • Responsável pela gestão das fabricas de FFO, afim de garantir a eficiência e produtividade do processo, garantindo o bom funcionamento das fabricas e melhor capacidade de processamento, manutenção, qualidade e capacidade produtiva de cada operação fabril;
  • Gerenciar colaboradores alocados na sua área de atuação, atuando em parceria com a área de Recursos Humanos, todas as políticas, programas, técnicas e procedimentos estabelecidos quanto a: recrutamento e seleção de novo colaborador, aplicação das políticas de remuneração e benefícios, identificação de necessidades de treinamento e desenvolvimento de pessoal, promoção de ambiente de trabalho saudável e favorável à produtividade, visando acompanhamento na qualidade da entrega do processo, retenção e desenvolvimento dos colaboradores.
  • Gestão da manutenção, a fim de garantir a funcionalidade das máquinas/equipamento para produção de alimentos - Ingredients, com foco na melhoria e adequação das fábricas, seja no aumento de capacidade de produção ou visibilidade de novos produtos.
  • Garantir a produção de vapor, energia, água e efluente, indicadores de qualidade/laboratório, manutenção, a fim de garantir o funcionamento da fábrica e desempenho no processamento de alimentos.
  • Gerenciar os Projetos Especiais ligados à área de infraestrutura de novos produtos de maneira ativa, in loco, através de cronogramas padrões informados a diretoria semanalmente, visando a melhoria de processos e qualidade da operação, e tecnologia para produção de alimentos.
  • Responsável pela gestão da manutenção das fábricas, garantindo a qualidade da produção de vapor, energia, água e efluente do processo, assim gerando o resultado esperado quanto ao processamento, bem como a sustentabilidade da operação.

Requirements And Qualifications

  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando em áreas como Engenharia de Produção, Administração ou áreas correlatadas;
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão da produção em rendering;
  • Habilidades de liderança e comunicação.

Process stages

  • Step 1: Registration
  • Step 2: Entrevista RH / Gestor
  • Step 3: Visita exploratória
  • Step 4: Hiring

Bem-vindo à Minerva Foods!

Líder na exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul, a Minerva Foods é mais do que uma empresa global – somos uma comunidade de profissionais com o propósito de seguir "criando conexões entre pessoas, alimentos e natureza". Atuamos em mais de 100 países, e contamos com unidades no Brasil, Paraguai, Argentina, Uruguai, Colômbia e plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália e no Chile.

Com uma gestão sólida e estratégias inovadoras, buscamos constantemente os mercados mais promissores, modernizando nossas operações e oferecendo produtos de alta qualidade. Nossa logística integrada e diversificação geográfica garantem soluções que atendem às mais rigorosas demandas globais.

Na Minerva Foods, sustentabilidade não é apenas um compromisso – é parte do nosso DNA. Adotamos práticas responsáveis que promovem a preservação ambiental, o bem-estar animal e a transparência em toda a cadeia de produção. Com iniciativas robustas de rastreabilidade, contribuímos para um futuro mais sustentável e transparente.

Nosso impacto global é sustentado por 46 unidades industriais, 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais. Esses pilares nos permitem entregar produtos saudáveis e nutritivos para clientes em todo o mundo.

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. RINA is currently recruiting for a Senior Environmental Consultant to join its office in São Paulo within the Sustainability and Business Innovation Division .

Mission

The Senior Environmental Consultant focuses on leading and overseeing the assessment and mitigation of environmental risks associated with energy, infrastructure, and industrial projects. They deliver permitting-related services, conduct environmental studies, environmental monitoring and modeling, compliance assessments, due diligence, and audits to evaluate compliance with Italian and European regulations or Project Financing standards. #LI-KM

Key Accountabilities

  1. Lead Environmental Impact Assessment Studies:
    • Lead and oversee comprehensive environmental impact assessments for energy, infrastructure, and industrial projects, analyzing factors such as air quality, water resources, and biodiversity.
    • Provide strategic guidance and technical expertise in conducting environmental studies to facilitate permitting and authorization processes, identifying potential risks and mitigation measures.
  2. Environmental and Social Due Diligences, Studies, and Audits:
    • Lead due diligence assessments to evaluate environmental and social risks associated with projects, ensuring thorough analysis and identification of potential impacts.
    • Oversee audits to ensure compliance with environmental regulations, social standards, and financial requirements, providing recommendations for improvement.
  3. Analysis of Pollutant Dispersion and Deposition:
    • Utilize advanced modeling techniques to simulate pollutant dispersion from energy facilities, evaluating potential impacts on air quality, water bodies, and soil.
    • Lead assessments of deposition patterns and concentrations of pollutants to estimate environmental effects and risks, providing expert recommendations for mitigation.
  4. Develop Tailored Mitigation Strategies:
    • Lead the development of tailored mitigation strategies to address environmental and social risks, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
    • Collaborate closely with project teams to integrate mitigation measures into project plans and financing agreements, providing technical guidance and oversight.
  5. Collaboration with Interdisciplinary Teams:
    • Work closely with engineers, economists, legal advisors, and other professionals to analyze data and assess project feasibility, providing expert input on environmental considerations throughout the project lifecycle.
    • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior consultants, fostering a collaborative and supportive team environment.
  6. Prepare Comprehensive Reports:
    • Lead the compilation and analysis of environmental data to prepare detailed reports for stakeholders, including investors, financiers, and regulatory authorities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with reporting standards.
    • Effectively communicate findings, risks, and mitigation strategies to support Project Financing activities and client decision-making processes.
  7. Support Proposal Preparation and Client Liaison:
    • Assist in preparing project proposals and financing documents, including environmental sections and risk assessments, providing expert input and guidance.
    • Engage proactively with clients and stakeholders to understand requirements and address environmental concerns during project development and financing negotiations, building strong client relationships.
  8. International Travel and Site Visits:
    • Travel internationally as required to conduct site visits and assess environmental, health, safety, and social aspects of projects, providing expert oversight and guidance.
    • Review and monitor environmental documentation, compliance measures, and project implementation on-site, ensuring adherence to environmental standards and requirements.
  9. Project Management Support:
    • Provide leadership and support for project management tasks, including monitoring budgets, schedules, and milestones, ensuring timely delivery of environmental deliverables and compliance with financing requirements.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated track record of successfully leading comprehensive environmental impact assessments for energy, infrastructure, and industrial projects.
  • Proven experience (8+ years) in environmental assessment methodologies and compliance with project financing environmental and social standards.
  • Expertise in utilizing advanced modeling techniques for pollutant dispersion and deposition analysis.
  • In-depth understanding and application of IFC Performance standards, ADB/EBRD/Equator Principles, or other international lenders’ standards in infrastructure and energy sectors.
  • Ability to perform air quality and noise modeling, and use Windpro for shadow flicker, noise, and visual impact assessments.
  • Experience in developing mitigation strategies to address environmental and social risks, ensuring compliance with regulations and industry standards.
  • Strong collaboration skills with interdisciplinary teams, providing expert environmental input throughout project lifecycles.

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Environmental Science or Engineering
  • Master’s Degree in Environmental Engineering

Additional Information

  • All positions are available to people with disabilities (PwD / PCD).

You will be part of Pandora Latin America Team in an international organization of can-do spirited, passionate, and performance-driven people.

We are seeking a creative and results-driven Retail Technology Services Analyst to join our Pandora LATAM team.

The Retail Technology Services Analyst is responsible for the overall Digital Store Operations service delivery to the Pandora stores in the Cluster(s) and must collaborate closely with multiple business stakeholders and Digital & Technology functions.

Pandora operates hundreds of stores in the cluster and within Brazil, and you will play a key role in managing the delivery of new stores, store services, and store support services. This position is in the Retail & Tech Operations organization, and you will have colleagues in many countries around the world.

The Retail Technology Services Analyst will support POS, Fiscal solutions (if any), hardware, and network in the stores, acting as SME for our Vendors and Support teams. He/She will manage and oversee several service providers, ensuring they deliver the agreed services on time and within budget. Some regional travel is expected.

This role requires creating structured overviews of tasks and results, which will be frequently presented to the line manager and stakeholders.

Duties include aligning with Retail DevOps teams, global service desk teams, platform teams, and business stakeholders to ensure consistent, resilient, and measurable support and operations of Pandora’s stores in the cluster.

Your Role as a Retail Technology Services Analyst:

  • Stakeholder Management:
  • Serve as the focal point for Retail stakeholders in the clusters and markets, collaborating closely with local retail business stakeholders and key resources.
  • Lead weekly/monthly meetings within the Cluster management teams and own Continuous Service Improvements.
  • Represent D&T as an ambassador in the Cluster.
  • Manage local business expectations aligned with global directions.
  • Service Management:
  • Ensure timely and effective IT service delivery, fulfilling SLAs and KPIs in collaboration with relevant teams.
  • Act as SME for POS support applications and represent the cluster for the DevOps POS team.
  • Manage escalations with global support teams and ensure problem management.
  • Document and onboard new technology solutions into Retail Support teams.
  • Focus on improving support services to Pandora stores.
  • Analyze retail store technology performance, identify issues, and implement solutions to enhance service quality, reduce costs, and increase stability.
  • Facilitate communication between IT Operations, other IT units, and business units to align IT services with organizational goals.
  • Develop processes and documentation for new store infrastructure implementations and upgrades.
  • Ensure hardware stock availability for operations.
  • Project Management:
  • Assist Delivery Managers in operational aspects of new store openings and related activities as a Subject Matter Expert.
  • Manage tasks and projects related to retail infrastructure and technology enhancements.
  • Lead implementation projects for new or improved infrastructure technologies or services.
  • Technology:
  • Be SME on all technology components within the retail environment and support their functioning.
  • Track and analyze retail infrastructure incidents, problems, and trends; identify training needs.
  • Develop and support services with Fiscal providers.
  • Assist in building a robust Operation Center (Detect & Fix approach).
  • Develop and improve retail service concepts.
  • Assist with hardware staging for stores, if needed.
  • Vendor Management:
  • Manage global partners and their deliveries within the region/cluster.
  • Coordinate with external suppliers to ensure service delivery based on demands and local solutions.

What is needed to succeed:

  • Field of Study: Data Science, IT, Communications, or similar.
  • 5+ years of experience with international Retail IT.
  • Service Management & Stakeholder Management skills.
  • Experience with Fiscal services.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and oral, with the ability to present ideas clearly to non-technical staff and end users.
  • Project management approach and mentality.
  • ITIL knowledge is mandatory; certification is a plus.

About Pandora

The world’s largest jewelry company, Pandora gives voice to millions’ love every day. Our jewelry is sold in over 100 countries through 6,800 points of sale, including over 2,700 concept stores.

We are committed to sustainability, with ambitious targets across our business, from sourcing to materials and marketing.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Engineer for our OpenStack Engineering team. This is an exciting opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, and OpenStack. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.

As a software engineer on the OpenStack Engineering team, you'll be building Charmed OpenStack and Ceph, a suite of open source Python based charms for deploying and managing OpenStack and Ceph. Your work will bring cloud platform technologies to a wide range of users and computing environments, from desktops to bare metal servers. This role requires a python software developer with a passion for automating infrastructure as code.

Applicants should be passionate about the future of the software defined datacenter, distributed systems, and open source. Canonical is a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion, and you will need to work well in that context. Engineers who thrive at Canonical are mindful of the dynamics of the open source ecosystem, and equally aware of the needs of large, innovative organizations.

This job involves international travel several times a year, usually for one week at a time.

What you'll do

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Ensure the success of OpenStack and Ceph on multiple architectures
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people

  • You have experience with non-x86 architectures, including s390, arm64, power and others

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros . Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.

Sobre a área de Ux Design

A área de Ux Design abrange todos os elementos que afetam a experiência do usuário . Este profissional atuará, em um ambiente ágil, estrategicamente na experiência do usuário, garantindo excelência de usabilidade nas interfaces dos produtos digitais e aplicativos da MAG Seguros. Garantindo a consistência dos produtos, seguindo as diretrizes do Design System para assegurar escalabilidade e coerência, aplicando boas práticas de branding.

  • Desmistificar a experiência do seguro de vida, tornando a contratação mais transparente e acessível;
  • Aprimorar cada ponto de contato e simplificar, de forma contínua, o ciclo de vida do cliente, corretor, beneficiário ou parceiro e suas interações com os produtos digitais da empresa;
  • Contribuir para uma jornada mais intuitiva, tornando-a mais clara e satisfatória, zelando pela consistência visual dos produtos digitais da MAG;
  • Medir e analisar o desempenho do produto digital em termos de experiência do usuário, utilizando ferramentas de análise para monitorar interações e identificar melhorias;
  • Pesquisar com os usuários, entendendo suas necessidades, comportamentos e motivações.

Desafios principais:

  • Garantir que a jornada dos produtos seja entregue conforme o planejado, priorizando a criação de personas, mapas de empatia, jornadas, discovery e Blueprint;
  • Disseminar a cultura de Ux design na empresa;
  • Atuar com Métodos de UX (levantamento de hipóteses, desk research, jornadas, testes de usabilidade, wireframes, acessibilidade, prototipação, delivery, avaliação e documentação);
  • Colaborar com operações, Tech Managers, Product Managers, Product Owners, Ux Designers e desenvolvedores (front-end e back-end);
  • Conduzir pesquisas, entrevistas e testes de usabilidade para validação de hipóteses;
  • Contribuir na estratégia dos produtos e serviços digitais, definindo o roadmap de implementação;
  • Realizar revisões constantes para melhorias, buscando tendências de mercado e gerando experiências inovadoras;
  • Ter conhecimento em Métodos Ágeis (Lean, Scrum, Kanban);
  • Acompanhar métricas de sucesso/experiência (SUS, NPS, CES, CSAT, taxas de erro e sucesso, comportamento do usuário);
  • Realizar apresentações e defender processos/princípios de design;
  • Atuar com autonomia nos projetos, garantindo visibilidade dos processos.

Requisitos do candidato:

  • Superior completo em cursos relacionados a Tecnologia, Marketing, Publicidade, Design ou áreas correlatas;

Competências técnicas desejadas:

  • Domínio de Usabilidade, Prototipação e ferramentas relacionadas;
  • Pesquisa com usuários e análise de mercado;
  • Arquitetura da informação (fluxogramas);
  • OKRs e Métricas de sucesso;
  • Elaboração de Roadmap;
  • Habilidades de apresentação, inteligência emocional, resiliência, comunicação clara e negociação;
  • Gestão de conflitos e proatividade no dia a dia.

Detalhes da vaga:

  • Modelo híbrido (4 a 8x por mês) no Centro do Rio de Janeiro.

Benefícios incluem salário compatível, vale refeição e alimentação, plano de saúde, auxílio creche, previdência privada, assistência funeral, seguro de vida, assistência psicológica, financeira e jurídica, atendimento médico e nutricional, folga no mês do aniversário, universidade corporativa, licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas.
